_: Captured from a live production scan of terrariumstation.com at crawlcheck.io on 2026-10-23. `images` is the service's own value, copied unaltered (its `provenance` block comes from a separate network read and is not part of this reader). The page itself is not committed; the live test re-fetches and refuses to compare unless the bytes still match.
digest_excludes: two edge-injected scripts that are not part of the page the site serves and change per request or per CDN release: the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon and the Cloudflare Zaraz loader (a fresh nonce on every response). The reader excludes <script> content before it counts anything.
